description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Webada, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.510812 (7782)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations, amendments to land title particulars, and servitude rights for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries about land parcels, their boundaries, encumbrances, and conditions related to land reform, all falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
